reason.en: Detection and alerts for a car that lives in a controlled space.
Alarm with a digital CAN-bus immobilizer — plus FD-CAN support for newer vehicles.
The complete system: detection, immobilization and live position tracking.
868 MHz communication and a 3D accelerometer, built for two wheels.
Control through Pandora Connect with energy-saving algorithms.
For motorcycles, the Evo V2 is the highest level in the range.
The first telemetric system for recreational vehicles, with wireless sensors that detect every attempt.
Immobilizer and anti-hijack included, with two wireless DMS-100 BT sensors.
The highest technology for caravans and camper vans: two GSM antennas, a LoRa remote and five wireless sensors.
Marine-grade version, built for conditions on board.
With position tracking — the level that matters for a boat at anchor.
A miniature tracker on AAA batteries, up to three years between changes.
4G tracking with its own battery and an output for a blocking relay.
Full security for commercial vehicles: 4G, GPS/GLONASS, engine blocking and fuel monitoring.

garage.en: In a closed garage the risk is lower — but theft by towing remains.

shared.en: In a shared parking space access is easy and observation is high; immobilization is worth it.

street.en: On the street, position tracking is the level that makes the biggest difference.

varies.en: When the location keeps changing, tracking is the only level that doesn't depend on where you are.
